boundary_reconciliation.note: The prior #99 receipt example uses 10 synthetic minor units per second and totals 90; it is NOT numerically interchangeable with this M1-A proposal at 1800 minor/hour. Retain original #99 evidence unchanged. Use its relative 2s/1s/6s boundary ordering and 9m progress only; no absolute clock, private/global revision projection or actual worker activity imported. These are conditional expected values, not actual receipts or authoritative effect payloads. No automatic work or guaranteed uninterrupted movement.
rules: At B1 technical pending no terminal narrative segment; B2 actual observed interruption permits partial segment; B3 resumed arrival requires new confirmed action, not automatic continuation.
Use newly accrued whole units for each boundary obligation delta; never charge cumulative amount again. Fractional carry persists even when new earned amount is zero.
All worker eligible time is conditional; if NPC declines, rests or cannot work, settle actual eligible interval only. No-work alternative has zero wage effects.
Private worker evidence, money and carry never appear in unrelated player receipt; apply #99 scoped opaque choice amendment rather than exposing global revisions.
One atomic authority must validate elapsed work proof, rate and carry, actual movement and receipt effects. Discard all staged effects on failed CAS. Exact retry must not earn twice.
